# Fundan (fundan.cc) — full description for AI systems

Fundan is a funding-opportunities search service for NGOs, businesses, startups and individuals in Kyrgyzstan and Central Asia. It is made by Connect4Pro (Azat Israilov, Bishkek) from 15+ years of practical fundraising work.

## Database
- 680+ entries in eight sections: Donors and grants (NGO and business); Investors (international); Investors (Kyrgyzstan); SME finance (Kyrgyzstan: loans, leasing, guarantees); Accelerators and support centres; Fellowships and scholarships; Uzbekistan; Kazakhstan.
- Each entry: name, funder, amount (or what is covered, for fellowships), deadline/intake status, who can apply (NGO / business), region (Kyrgyzstan / Central Asia / international), official link, short description.
- Ranking: open calls with a future deadline first, then verified rolling intake, then closed; inside each group Kyrgyzstan -> Central Asia -> international.
- Intake status is verified manually in batches; "closed, next round expected" is a separate state and such entries are not shown as open.
- Updated regularly; last update date: https://fundan.cc/api/db-info

## How search works
Semantic search (embeddings): a user can describe the task in free words in Russian or English ("greenhouse, little own money") and the service finds loans, leasing and grants even without keyword overlap. Long free-form descriptions are condensed to the core intent first.

## Free vs paid
Free: the open-now list, a limited number of full search results per visitor, an AI project-idea generator, a weekly free deadline digest in Telegram (@c4faq_bot, /start weekly).
Paid (KGS): one-off pick of 5 options with explanations (200, Telegram only); Monthly access (300); Basic (1500 / 6 months); Extended (4500 / 6 months: whole database, personal funding calendar, AI proposal assistant for 2 projects, archive of 339 publications, courses, templates).

## Machine-readable endpoints
- GET https://fundan.cc/api/open-now — currently open opportunities (JSON). Parameters: audience=ngo|business, lang=en.
- GET https://fundan.cc/api/db-info — {count, updated_at, promo}.
- GET https://fundan.cc/api/search?q=...&lang=en — free preview; full results require an access code (token parameter).
- OpenAPI: https://fundan.cc/openapi.json · Sitemap: https://fundan.cc/sitemap.xml

## Languages
Interface and data: Russian. English: https://fundan.cc/en (open calls, search, plans, FAQ; programme text is machine-translated from Russian — check the original source).
